## Better
- My coding saved for one module is never offered to another module that uses the same CAFD.
- Code several changes refuses two ticked changes that set the same setting, and names every My coding change in its question.
- If a change in the FDL-Editor can only be put back partly, it says so and keeps it for Undo.
- An update never installs over an E-Sys or E-Sys MAX window opened during the download.
- Repairing the E-Sys menu entry now also removes a second E-Sys MAX entry, and E-Sys file backups are never overwritten.
- Settings saved at the same moment by two windows no longer overwrite each other.
